name: r5-live-factory-complete-protocol
budget_rationale: Complete R3 representative 15-to-1 T protocol including all executed adaptive stages, accepted/rejected path, same-carrier output conversion, real live-data consumption and cleanup, in the R4 server-placed 205-carrier world. This is a representative route, not full Shor completion. R5 four-patch 12-node first integration used 307 seconds locally including 5 compile windows; each factory stage receives 3600 seconds and 100000 operation capacity, with 4 hours total and 16 GiB sampled process-tree RSS, single process. Search expansions are recorded by R7 and are not claimed enforced by the physical compiler; stage wall/operation limits are enforced. Persistent stage checkpoints preserve prefixes on exhaustion. Measure stage costs before scaling all 817 static T/TDG requests; do not truncate a physical stage or call budget exhaustion infeasibility. Full 205-carrier placement is reused, not recomputed.
